e: Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehl,
Shalok:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I bow to the Primal Guru.
I bow to the Guru of the ages.
I bow to the True Guru.
I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.
Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.
His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.
The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,
were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.
That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells

g: qw kI mihmw gnI n AwvY ]
t: taa kee mahimaa ganee na aavai.
e: - the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.
Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan
- Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||
Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

g: Bgq jnw kY min ibsRwm ] rhwau ]

e: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||

e: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.

g: pRB kY ismrin dUKu jmu nsY ]

e: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
Remembering God, death is eliminated.
Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.

g: pRB ismrq kCu ibGnu n lwgY ]

e: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.
Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

g: pRB kY ismrin Bau n ibAwpY ]

e: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.

g: pRB kY ismrin duKu n sMqwpY ]

e: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.

g: pRB kw ismrnu swD kY sMig ]

e: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.
All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

g: pRB kY ismrin iriD isiD nau iniD ]
t: parabh kai simran riDh siDh na-o niDh.
e: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

g: pRB kY ismrin igAwnu iDAwnu qqu buiD ]

e: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.

e: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

g: pRB kY ismrin hoie su Blw ]
t: parabh kai simran ho-ay so bhalaa.
e: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.
Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

g: pRB kw ismrnu sB qy aUcw ]
t: parabh kaa simran sabh tay oochaa.
e: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

g: pRB kY ismrin sBu ikCu suJY ]

e: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

g: pRB kY ismrin nwhI jm qRwsw ]

e: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

g: pRB kY ismrin mn kI mlu jwie ]
t: parabh kai simran man kee mal jaa-ay.
e: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

g: pRB jI bsih swD kI rsnw ]
t: parabh jee baseh saaDh kee rasnaa.
e: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.
Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||
Those who remember God are wealthy.
Those who remember God are honorable.

g: pRB kau ismrih sy jn prvwn ]

e: Those who remember God are approved.

g: pRB kau ismrih sy purK pRDwn ]
t: parabh ka-o simrahi say purakh parDhaan.
e: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
Those who remember God are not lacking.

g: pRB kau ismrih is srb ky rwjy ]
t: parabh ka-o simrahi se sarab kay raajay.
e: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
Those who remember God dwell in peace.
Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

e: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.
Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||
Those who remember God generously help others.

g: pRB kau ismrih iqn sd bilhwrI ]

e: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

g: pRB kau ismrih sy muK suhwvy ]

e: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

g: pRB kau ismrih iqn sUiK ibhwvY ]

e: Those who remember God abide in peace.

g: pRB kau ismrih iqn Awqmu jIqw ]

e: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

g: pRB kau ismrih iqn inrml rIqw ]
t: parabh ka-o simrahi tin nirmal reetaa.
e: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

g: pRB kau ismrih iqn And Gnyry ]
t: parabh ka-o simrahi tin anad ghanayray.
e: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

g: pRB kau ismrih bsih hir nyry ]
t: parabh ka-o simrahi baseh har nayray.
e: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||
Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

g: pRB kY ismrin kbhu n JUry ]
t: parabh kai simran kabahu na jhooray.
e: Remembering God, one never grieves.

g: pRB kY ismrin hir gun bwnI ]
t: parabh kai simran har gun baanee.
e: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

g: suKu pRB ismrn kw AMqu n pwr ]
t: sukh parabh simran kaa ant na paar.
e: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

g: ismrih sy jn ijn kau pRB mieAw ]
t: simrahi say jan jin ka-o parabh ma-i-aa.
e: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||
Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

g: hir ismrin Bey isD jqI dwqy ]
t: har simran bha-ay siDh jatee daatay.
e: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

g: hir ismrin nIc chu kuMt jwqy ]
t: har simran neech chahu kunt jaatay.
e: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.
For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.
Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.
In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.
By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

g: nwnk gurmuiK hir ismrnu iqin pwieAw ]8]1]
t: naanak gurmukh har simran tin paa-i-aa. ||8||1||
e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||
Shalok:

g: dIn drd duK BMjnw Git Git nwQ AnwQ ]
t: deen darad dukh bhanjnaa ghat ghat naath anaath.
e: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

g: srix qum@wrI AwieE nwnk ky pRB swQ ]1]
t: saran tumHaaree aa-i-o naanak kay parabh saath. ||1||
e: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||
Ashtapadee:

g: jh mwq ipqw suq mIq n BweI ]
t: jah maat pitaa sut meet na bhaa-ee.
e: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

g: mn aUhw nwmu qyrY sMig shweI ]
t: man oohaa naam tayrai sang sahaa-ee.
e: - O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

g: jh mhw BieAwn dUq jm dlY ]
t: jah mahaa bha-i-aan doot jam dalai.
e: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

g: qh kyvl nwmu sMig qyrY clY ]
t: tah kayval naam sang tayrai chalai.
e: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.
Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

g: hir ko nwmu iKn mwih auDwrI ]
t: har ko naam khin maahi uDhaaree.
e: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.
By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

g: hir ko nwmu koit pwp prhrY ]
t: har ko naam kot paap parharai.
e: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.
As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.
O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||
The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

g: hir kw nwmu jpq hoie suKIAw ]
t: har kaa naam japat ho-ay sukhee-aa.
e: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.
Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

g: Aink mwieAw rMg iqK n buJwvY ]
t: anik maa-i-aa rang tikh na bujhaavai.
e: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.
Upon that path where you must go all alone,

g: qh hir nwmu sMig hoq suhylw ]
t: tah har naam sang hot suhaylaa.
e: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.
On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.
O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||
You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.
Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.
Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,
the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.
Through countless incarnations, people are born and die.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

g: hau mYlw mlu kbhu n DovY ]
t: ha-o mailaa mal kabahu na Dhovai.
e: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

g: hir kw nwmu koit pwp KovY ]
t: har kaa naam kot paap khovai.
e: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.
Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.
O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

g: ijh mwrg ky gny jwih n kosw ]
t: jih maarag kay ganay jaahi na kosaa.
e: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

g: hir kw nwmu aUhw sMig qosw ]
t: har kaa naam oohaa sang tosaa.
e: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.
On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,
the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

g: jhw pMiQ qyrw ko n is\wnU ]
t: jahaa panth tayraa ko na sinjaanoo.
e: On that journey where no one knows you,

g: hir kw nwmu qh nwil pCwnU ]
t: har kaa naam tah naal pachhaanoo.
e: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

g: jh mhw BieAwn qpiq bhu Gwm ]
t: jah mahaa bha-i-aan tapat baho ghaam.
e: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

g: qh hir ky nwm kI qum aUpir Cwm ]
t: tah har kay naam kee tum oopar chhaam.
e: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.
Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

g: qh nwnk hir hir AMimRqu brKY ]4]
t: tah naanak har har amrit barkhai. ||4||
e: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||
Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.
The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

g: hir kw nwmu dws kI Et ]
t: har kaa naam daas kee ot.
e: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

g: hir kY nwim auDry jn koit ]
t: har kai naam uDhray jan kot.
e: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

g: hir jsu krq sMq idnu rwiq ]
t: har jas karat sant din raat.
e: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

g: hir jn kY hir nwmu inDwnu ]
t: har jan kai har naam niDhaan.
e: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.
The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

g: mn qn rMig rqy rMg eykY ]
t: man tan rang ratay rang aykai.
e: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.
O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

g: hir kw nwmu jn kau mukiq jugiq ]
t: har kaa naam jan ka-o mukat jugat.
e: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

g: hir kY nwim jn kau iqRpiq Bugiq ]
t: har kai naam jan ka-o taripat bhugat.
e: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

g: hir kw nwmu jn kw rUp rMgu ]
t: har kaa naam jan kaa roop rang.
e: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

g: hir nwmu jpq kb prY n BMgu ]
t: har naam japat kab parai na bhang.
e: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

g: hir kw nwmu jn kI vifAweI ]
t: har kaa naam jan kee vadi-aa-ee.
e: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

g: hir kY nwim jn soBw pweI ]
t: har kai naam jan sobhaa paa-ee.
e: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

g: hir kw nwmu jn kau Bog jog ]
t: har kaa naam jan ka-o bhog jog.
e: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

g: hir nwmu jpq kCu nwih ibEgu ]
t: har naam japat kachh naahi bi-og.
e: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

g: jnu rwqw hir nwm kI syvw ]
t: jan raataa har naam kee sayvaa.
e: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

g: hir hir jn kY mwlu KjInw ]
t: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa.
e: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

g: hir Dnu jn kau Awip pRiB dInw ]
t: har Dhan jan ka-o aap parabh deenaa.
e: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

g: hir hir jn kY Et sqwxI ]
t: har har jan kai ot sataanee.
e: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

g: hir pRqwip jn Avr n jwxI ]

e: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

g: Eiq poiq jn hir ris rwqy ]

e: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.
In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

g: AwT phr jnu hir hir jpY ]
t: aath pahar jan har har japai.
e: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

g: hir kw Bgqu pRgt nhI CpY ]

e: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

g: hir kI Bgiq mukiq bhu kry ]
t: har kee bhagat mukat baho karay.
e: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.
O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||
This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.
The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

g: sB qy aUqm hir kI kQw ]
t: sabh tay ootam har kee kathaa.
e: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.
Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

g: nwm kI mihmw sMq ird vsY ]
t: naam kee mahimaa sant rid vasai.
e: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.
By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.
The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.
Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

g: nwm quil kCu Avru n hoie ]
t: naam tul kachh avar na ho-ay.
e: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

g: nwnk gurmuiK nwmu pwvY jnu koie ]8]2]
t: naanak gurmukh naam paavai jan ko-ay. ||8||2||
e: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||
Shalok:

g: bhu swsqR bhu isimRqI pyKy srb FFoil ]
t: baho saastar baho simritee paykhay sarab dhadhol.
e: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

g: pUjis nwhI hir hry nwnk nwm Amol ]1]
t: poojas naahee har haray naanak naam amol. ||1||
e: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;
the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;
the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;
the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;
the performance of all sorts of works;
donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;
cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;
keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts
- none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

g: nwnk gurmuiK nwmu jpIAY iek bwr ]1]
t: naanak gurmukh naam japee-ai ik baar. ||1||
e: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

g: nau KMf ipRQmI iPrY icru jIvY ]
t: na-o khand parithmee firai chir jeevai.
e: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;
you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation
and burn yourself in fire;
you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;
you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;
you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;
piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

g: qau BI haumY mYlu n jwvY ]
t: ta-o bhee ha-umai mail na jaavai.
e: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

g: hir ky nwm smsir kCu nwih ]
t: har kay naam samsar kachh naahi.
e: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

g: nwnk gurmuiK nwmu jpq giq pwih ]2]
t: naanak gurmukh naam japat gat paahi. ||2||
e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||
With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

g: grbu gumwnu n mn qy hutY ]
t: garab gumaan na man tay hutai.
e: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.
You may practice cleansing day and night,

g: mn kI mYlu n qn qy jwiq ]
t: man kee mail na tan tay jaat.
e: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

g: iesu dyhI kau bhu swDnw krY ]
t: is dayhee ka-o baho saaDhnaa karai.
e: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

g: mn qy kbhU n ibiKAw trY ]
t: man tay kabhoo na bikhi-aa tarai.
e: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.
You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,
but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

g: mn hir ky nwm kI mihmw aUc ]
t: man har kay naam kee mahimaa ooch.
e: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

g: nwnk nwim auDry piqq bhu mUc ]3]
t: naanak naam uDhray patit baho mooch. ||3||
e: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

g: bhuqu isAwxp jm kw Bau ibAwpY ]
t: bahut si-aanap jam kaa bha-o bi-aapai.
e: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

g: Aink jqn kir iqRsn nw DRwpY ]
t: anik jatan kar tarisan naa Dharaapai.
e: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.
Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.
Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.
You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,
if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.
All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

g: goivMd Bjn ibnu iqlu nhI mwnY ]
t: govind bhajan bin til nahee maanai.
e: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

g: hir kw nwmu jpq duKu jwie ]
t: har kaa naam japat dukh jaa-ay.
e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.
O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||
One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
should commit himself to the service of the Saints.
If you wish to erase your sorrows,

g: hir hir nwmu irdY sd gwvY ]
t: har har naam ridai sad gaavai.
e: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.
If you long for honor for yourself,
then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

g: jy ko jnm mrx qy frY ]
t: jay ko janam maran tay darai.
e: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,
then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

g: ijsu jn kau pRB drs ipAwsw ]
t: jis jan ka-o parabh daras pi-aasaa.
e: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

g: nwnk qw kY bil bil jwsw ]5]
t: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa. ||5||
e: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||
Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.
One who sees himself as lowly,
shall be accounted as the highest of all.

g: jw kw mnu hoie sgl kI rInw ]
t: jaa kaa man ho-ay sagal kee reenaa.
e: One whose mind is the dust of all,

g: hir hir nwmu iqin Git Git cInw ]
t: har har naam tin ghat ghat cheenaa.
e: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.
One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,
looks upon all the world as his friend.
One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,
O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||
To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
To the homeless, Your Name is home.
To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.
To all, You are the Giver of gifts.
O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,
Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:
You alone know Your own condition and state.
You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.
You alone can celebrate Your Praises.
O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||
Of all religions, the best religion

g: hir ko nwmu jip inrml krmu ]
t: har ko naam jap nirmal karam.

e: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;
what is your origin, and what is your appearance?
He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you
- in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.
In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.
In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.

g: ijh pRswid Dr aUpir suiK bsih ]

You are provided with all the necessities of life.

From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

g: iqs isau pRIiq n krY gvwru ]

Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

e: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.

like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.
They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.
Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||
They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
They curse others day and night.
Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.
They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.
Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,
but within clings the dog of greed.
The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.
There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

g: jw kY AMqir bsY pRBu Awip ]

e: Those, within whom God Himself abides
- O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
By listening, how can the blind find the path?
Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.
How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?
Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.
How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

g: jqn krY qau BI sur BMg ]

He simply cannot go there.

He shows love to his enemies.
He lives in a castle of sand.
He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.
He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.
Death does not even come to mind for the fool.
Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,
falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:
So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

g: nwnk rwiK lyhu Awpn kir krm ]7]

e: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||
You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
This body and soul are all Your property.

e: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.
In Your Grace, there are so many joys!
No one knows Your limits.
O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,
the whole creation is strung on Your thread.
That which has come from You is under Your Command.

g: qumrI giq imiq qum hI jwnI ]

e: You alone know Your state and extent.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||

He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;
for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

g: eyk BI n dyie ds BI ihir lyie ]

Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.
Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

e: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet
- all pleasures come to abide in his mind.
One who abides by the Lord's Will,
O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||
God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

g: ApunI Amwn kCu bhuir swhu lyie ]

e: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,
the ignorant person shows his anger.
He himself destroys his own credibility,

e: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,
and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
the Lord will make him happy four times over.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||

Whatever is seen, shall pass away;
and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.
One who gives her love to a passing traveler

g: qw kau hwiQ n AwvY kyh ]
t: taa ka-o haath na aavai kayh.
e: - nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

g: mn hir ky nwm kI pRIiq suKdweI ]

e: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

e: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||
False are body, wealth, and all relations.
False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.
False are power, youth, wealth and property.
False are sexual desire and wild anger.
False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

g: imiQAw rMg sMig mwieAw pyiK hsqw ]

e: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.
False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.
False are pride and self-conceit.
Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

g: nwnk jip jip jIvY hir ky crn ]4]

e: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||
False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.
False is the body which does not do good to others.
False is the nose which inhales corruption.
Without understanding, everything is false.

g: sPl dyh nwnk hir hir nwm ley ]5]

e: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||
The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?
Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.
From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

g: ibnu ismrn idnu rYin ibRQw ibhwie ]

like the crop which withers without rain.

e: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.
He is not impressed by outward display.
One who does not practice what he preaches to others,
shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.
One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord
- by his teachings, the world is saved.

Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||

He Himself values His own creatures.
He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

He is pervading all places and interspaces.
Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.
Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||

By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;
O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||
By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?
By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

g: mn AwT phr qw kw jsu gwvIjY ]

e: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

e: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;

e: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.
By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;
O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
attune yourself to that Loving Lord.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

g: mn suKu pwvih hir hir jsu khq ]

e: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

g: ijh pRswid quJu ko n phUcY ]

e: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

g: mn swis swis ismrhu pRB aUcy ]

e: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.
By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;
O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||
By His Grace, you wear decorations;

g: mn iqsu ismrq ikau Awlsu kIjY ]

e: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?
By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

e: O mind, never forget that God.
By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;
keep God enshrined in your heart.
O mind, the One who formed your form
- standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.
Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;
here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

g: ijh pRswid krih puMn bhu dwn ]

e: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

By His Grace, you have such high social status;

g: so pRBu ismir sdw idn rwiq ]

e: remember God always, day and night.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||
By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.
By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.
By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.
By His Grace, your hands move and work.
By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.
By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.
By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

g: AYsw pRBu iqAwig Avr kq lwghu ]

e: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||
By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

g: iqsu pRB kau mUil n mnhu ibswir ]

e: never forget God from your mind.
By His Grace, you have prestige;

By His Grace, your works are completed;

By His Grace, you find the Truth;

g: ry mn myry qUM qw isau rwcu ]

O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||
Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

g: Awip gwvwey su hir gun gwau ]

e: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.
By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

g: pRB dieAw qy miq aUqm hoie ]

e: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.
All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.
No one obtains anything by himself.

e: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

e: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||

Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

g: jo jo khY su mukqw hoie ]

e: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

g: suin mIqw nwnku ibnvMqw ] swD jnw kI Acrj kQw ]1]

Ashtapadee:

e: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.
In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.
In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.
In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

g: swD kY sMig buJY pRBu nyrw ]
t: saaDh kai sang bujhai parabh nayraa.
e: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.
In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

t: saaDh kai sang paa-ay naam ratan.
e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

e: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

e: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

g: nwnk swD kI soBw pRB mwih smwnI ]1]
t: naanak saaDh kee sobhaa parabh maahi samaanee. ||1||
e: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||
In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

g: swD kY sMig Awvih bis pMcw ]

e: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.
In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.
In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.
In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

g: swD kY sMig n kqhUM DwvY ]
t: saaDh kai sang na katahooN Dhaavai.
e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.
In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

g: swD kY sMig mwieAw qy iBMn ]
t: saaDh kai sang maa-i-aa tay bhinn.
e: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.
In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||
In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.

The God-conscious being is always unattached,

The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

g: jYsy rwj rMk kau lwgY quil pvwn ]

The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

g: bRhm igAwnI kI sB aUpir mieAw ]

Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
The God-conscious being shall never perish.
The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.
The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.
The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.
The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

g: bRhm igAwnI kY hoie su Blw ]

In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

g: nwnk bRhm igAwnI jpY sgl sMswru ]4]

e: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||
The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

g: bRhm igAwnI kY bsY pRBu sMg ]
t: barahm gi-aanee kai basai parabh sang.
e: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

The God-conscious being is carefree.

g: bRhm igAwnI kY sgl mn mwih ]

He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

As is honor, so is dishonor.
As is the beggar, so is the king.
Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

Many millions become austere penitents.
Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.

Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.
Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.
Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.
Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.
Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.
Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.

g: keI koit dyv dwnv ieMdR isir CqR ]
t: ka-ee kot dayv daanav indar sir chhatar.
e: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.
He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

g: nwnk ijsu ijsu BwvY iqsu iqsu insqwrY ]3]
t: naanak jis jis bhaavai tis tis nistaarai. ||3||
e: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||
Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

g: keI koit byd purwn isimRiq Aru swsq ]
t: ka-ee kot bayd puraan simrit ar saasat.
e: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.
Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.
Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.
Many millions are made long-lived.

g: keI koit igrI myr suvrn QIvy ]
t: ka-ee kot giree mayr suvran theevay.
e: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.
Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

g: keI koit BUq pRyq sUkr imRgwc ]
t: ka-ee kot bhoot parayt sookar marigaach.
e: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

g: sB qy nyrY sBhU qy dUir ]
t: sabh tay nayrai sabhhoo tay door.
e: He is near to all, and yet far from all;
O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||
Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.
Many millions are born, live and die.
Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.
Many millions eat while sitting at ease.
Many millions are exhausted by their labors.
Many millions are created wealthy.
Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

g: jh jh Bwxw qh qh rwKy ]
t: jah jah bhaanaa tah tah raakhay.
e: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

g: nwnk sBu ikCu pRB kY hwQy ]5]
t: naanak sabh kichh parabh kai haathay. ||5||
e: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||
Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

g: rwm nwm sMig iqin ilv lwgI ]
t: raam naam sang tin liv laagee.
e: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.
Many millions are searching for God.
Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.
Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.
They meet with God, the Eternal.
Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.
They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

g: nwnk qy jn sdw Din DMin ]6]
t: naanak tay jan sadaa Dhan Dhan. ||6||
e: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||
Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.
Many millions are the divine incarnations.
In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.
So many times, He has expanded His expansion.
Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.
Many millions are created in various forms.

g: pRB qy hoey pRB mwih smwiq ]
t: parabh tay ho-ay parabh maahi samaat.
e: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

g: qw kw AMqu n jwnY koie ]
t: taa kaa ant na jaanai ko-ay.
e: His limits are not known to anyone.
Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||
Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
Their souls are enlightened.
Many millions know the essence of reality.
Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.
Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

g: Amr Bey sd sd hI jIvih ]
t: amar bha-ay sad sad hee jeeveh.
e: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.
Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.
They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

g: Apuny jn kau swis swis smwry ]
t: apunay jan ka-o saas saas samaaray.
e: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.
O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||
Shalok:

g: krx kwrx pRBu eyku hY dUsr nwhI koie ]
t: karan kaaran parabh ayk hai doosar naahee ko-ay.
e: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

g: nwnk iqsu bilhwrxY jil Qil mhIAil soie ]1]
t: naanak tis balihaarnai jal thal mahee-al so-ay. ||1||
e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.
That which pleases Him, comes to pass.
In an instant, He creates and destroys.
He has no end or limitation.
By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.
By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.
By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.
By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.
Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.
O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||
If it pleases God, one attains salvation.
If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

g: pRB BwvY ibnu sws qy rwKY ]
t: parabh bhaavai bin saas tay raakhai.
e: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

g: pRB BwvY qw hir gux BwKY ]
t: parabh bhaavai taa har gun bhaakhai.
e: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.
If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.
He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
As He wills, He causes actions to be done.
Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

g: khu mwnuK qy ikAw hoie AwvY ]
t: kaho maanukh tay ki-aa ho-ay aavai.
e: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?
Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

g: ies kY hwiQ hoie qw sBu ikCu lyie ]
t: is kai haath ho-ay taa sabh kichh lay-ay.
e: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.
Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.
Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.
If they knew better, they would save themselves.
Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

g: inmK mwih cwir kuMt iPir AwvY ]
t: nimakh maahi chaar kunt fir aavai.
e: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

g: kir ikrpw ijsu ApnI Bgiq dyie ]
t: kar kirpaa jis apnee bhagat day-ay.
e: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship
- O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||

g: iKn mih nIc kIt kau rwj ]
t: khin meh neech keet ka-o raaj.
e: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.
The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

g: jw kw idRsit kCU n AwvY ]
t: jaa kaa darisat kachhoo na aavai.
e: Even one who has never been seen at all,
becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.
And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

g: qw kw lyKw n gnY jgdIs ]
t: taa kaa laykhaa na ganai jagdees.
e: - the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

g: jIau ipMfu sB iqs kI rwis ]
t: jee-o pind sabh tis kee raas.
e: Soul and body are all His property.
Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.
He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.
Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

g: ies kw blu nwhI iesu hwQ ]
t: is kaa bal naahee is haath.
e: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.
The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

g: jo iqsu BwvY soeI Puin QIau ]
t: jo tis bhaavai so-ee fun thee-o.
e: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.
Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.
Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.
Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.
Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.
Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.
O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||
Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.
Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.
Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.
Sometimes, they sit as great kings.
Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.
Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.
Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

g: ijau pRBu rwKY iqv hI rhY ]
t: ji-o parabh raakhai tiv hee rahai.
e: As God keeps them, so they remain.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||
Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.
Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.
Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

g: kbhU kIt hsiq pqMg hoie jIAw ]
t: kabhoo keet hasat patang ho-ay jee-aa.
e: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.
They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.
In various costumes, like actors, they appear.
As it pleases God, they dance.
Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||
Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

g: ausu AsQwn qy bhuir n AwvY ]
t: us asthaan tay bahur na aavai.
e: From that place, he does not have to come back again.
The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.
That place does not perish.

g: mn qn nwim rqy iek rMig ]
t: man tan naam ratay ik rang.
e: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

g: ijau jl mih jlu Awie Ktwnw ]
t: ji-o jal meh jal aa-ay khataanaa.
e: As water comes to blend with water,
his light blends into the Light.
Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||
Shalok:

g: suKI bsY mskInIAw Awpu invwir qly ]
t: sukhee basai maskeenee-aa aap nivaar talay.
e: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

g: bfy bfy AhMkwrIAw nwnk grib gly ]1]
t: baday baday ahaNkaaree-aa naanak garab galay. ||1||
e: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One who has the pride of power within,
shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.
One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,
shall become a maggot in manure.
One who claims to act virtuously,
shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

g: Dn BUim kw jo krY gumwnu ]
t: Dhan bhoom kaa jo karai gumaan.
e: One who takes pride in wealth and lands
is a fool, blind and ignorant.

g: kir ikrpw ijs kY ihrdY grIbI bswvY ]
t: kar kirpaa jis kai hirdai gareebee basaavai.
e: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

g: nwnk eIhw mukqu AwgY suKu pwvY ]1]
t: naanak eehaa mukat aagai sukh paavai. ||1||
e: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||
One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

g: iqRx smwin kCu sMig n jwvY ]
t: tarin samaan kachh sang na jaavai.
e: - not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

g: bhu lskr mwnuK aUpir kry Aws ]
t: baho laskar maanukh oopar karay aas.
e: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

g: pl BIqir qw kw hoie ibnws ]
t: pal bheetar taa kaa ho-ay binaas.
e: but he shall vanish in an instant.
One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,
in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.
One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self
- the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

g: gur pRswid jw kw imtY AiBmwnu ]
t: gur parsaad jaa kaa mitai abhimaan.
e: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,
O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,
he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.
If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,
he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

g: Aink jqn kir Awqm nhI dRvY ]
t: anik jatan kar aatam nahee darvai.
e: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened
- how can he go to the Court of the Lord?
One who calls himself good
- goodness shall not draw near him.

g: srb kI ryn jw kw mnu hoie ]
t: sarab kee rayn jaa kaa man ho-ay.
e: One whose mind is the dust of all

g: khu nwnk qw kI inrml soie ]3]
t: kaho naanak taa kee nirmal so-ay. ||3||
e: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||

g: jb lgu jwnY muJ qy kCu hoie ]
t: jab lag jaanai mujh tay kachh ho-ay.
e: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

g: qb ies kau suKu nwhI koie ]
t: tab is ka-o sukh naahee ko-ay.
e: he shall have no peace.

g: jb ieh jwnY mY ikCu krqw ]
t: jab ih jaanai mai kichh kartaa.
e: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

g: qb lgu grB join mih iPrqw ]
t: tab lag garabh jon meh firtaa.
e: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.
As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,
his mind shall not come to rest.

g: jb lgu moh mgn sMig mwie ]
t: jab lag moh magan sang maa-ay.
e: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

g: qb lgu Drm rwie dyie sjwie ]
t: tab lag Dharam raa-ay day-ay sajaa-ay.
e: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.
By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

g: shs Kty lK kau auiT DwvY ]
t: sahas khatay lakh ka-o uth Dhaavai.
e: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

g: iqRpiq n AwvY mwieAw pwCY pwvY ]
t: taripat na aavai maa-i-aa paachhai paavai.
e: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.
He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,
but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.
Without contentment, no one is satisfied.
Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.
Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.
Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.
He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.
Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?
As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.
God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

g: jo ikCu kIno su ApnY rMig ]
t: jo kichh keeno so apnai rang.
e: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

g: sB qy dUir sBhU kY sMig ]
t: sabh tay door sabhhoo kai sang.
e: He is far from all, and yet with all.
He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

g: mrY n ibnsY AwvY n jwie ]
t: marai na binsai aavai na jaa-ay.
e: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||
He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
He Himself mingles with all.
He Himself created His own expanse.

g: sBu kCu aus kw Ehu krnYhwru ]
t: sabh kachh us kaa oh karnaihaar.
e: All things are His; He is the Creator.

g: aus qy iBMn khhu ikCu hoie ]
t: us tay bhinn kahhu kichh ho-ay.
e: Without Him, what could be done?
In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.
In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.
He produces His plays with infinite variety.

g: mn mih Awip mn Apuny mwih ]
t: man meh aap man apunay maahi.
e: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.
O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||
True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.
By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.
True, True, True is the Creator of all.
Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.
Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.
You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.
Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,
heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.
Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure
- chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||
Shalok:

g: sMq srin jo jnu prY so jnu auDrnhwr ]
t: sant saran jo jan parai so jan uDhranhaar.
e: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

g: sMq kI inMdw nwnkw bhuir bhuir Avqwr ]1]
t: sant kee nindaa naankaa bahur bahur avtaar. ||1||
e: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

g: sMq kY dUKin jm qy nhI CutY ]
t: sant kai dookhan jam tay nahee chhutai.
e: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

g: sMq kY dUKin suKu sBu jwie ]
t: sant kai dookhan sukh sabh jaa-ay.
e: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

g: sMq kY dUKin nrk mih pwie ]
t: sant kai dookhan narak meh paa-ay.
e: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

g: sMq kY dUKin miq hoie mlIn ]
t: sant kai dookhan mat ho-ay maleen.
e: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

g: sMq kY dUKin soBw qy hIn ]
t: sant kai dookhan sobhaa tay heen.
e: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

g: sMq ky hqy kau rKY n koie ]
t: sant kay hatay ka-o rakhai na ko-ay.
e: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

g: sMq kY dUKin Qwn BRstu hoie ]
t: sant kai dookhan thaan bharsat ho-ay.
e: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.
But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,
O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||

g: sMq ky dUKn qy muKu BvY ]
t: sant kay dookhan tay mukh bhavai.
e: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

g: sMqn kY dUKin kwg ijau lvY ]
t: santan kai dookhan kaag ji-o lavai.
e: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

g: sMqn kY dUKin srp join pwie ]
t: santan kai dookhan sarap jon paa-ay.
e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

g: sMq kY dUKin iqRgd join ikrmwie ]
t: sant kai dookhan tarigad jon kirmaa-ay.
e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

g: sMqn kY dUKin iqRsnw mih jlY ]
t: santan kai dookhan tarisnaa meh jalai.
e: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

g: sMq kY dUKin sBu ko ClY ]
t: sant kai dookhan sabh ko chhalai.
e: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

g: sMq kY dUKin qyju sBu jwie ]
t: sant kai dookhan tayj sabh jaa-ay.
e: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.
Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

g: sMq doKI kw Qwau ko nwih ]
t: sant dokhee kaa thaa-o ko naahi.
e: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.

g: nwnk sMq BwvY qw Eie BI giq pwih ]2]
t: naanak sant bhaavai taa o-ay bhee gat paahi. ||2||
e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||
The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

g: sMq kw inMdku iKnu itknu n pweI ]
t: sant kaa nindak khin tikan na paa-ee.
e: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.
The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.
The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

g: sMq kw inMdku rwj qy hInu ]
t: sant kaa nindak raaj tay heen.
e: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

g: sMq kw inMdku duKIAw Aru dInu ]
t: sant kaa nindak dukhee-aa ar deen.
e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

g: sMq ky inMdk kau srb rog ]
t: sant kay nindak ka-o sarab rog.
e: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

g: sMq ky inMdk kau sdw ibjog ]
t: sant kay nindak ka-o sadaa bijog.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

g: sMq kI inMdw doK mih doKu ]
t: sant kee nindaa dokh meh dokh.
e: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

g: nwnk sMq BwvY qw aus kw BI hoie moKu ]3]
t: naanak sant bhaavai taa us kaa bhee ho-ay mokh. ||3||
e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||
The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

g: sMq kw doKI iksY kw nhI imqu ]
t: sant kaa dokhee kisai kaa nahee mit.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

g: sMq ky doKI kau fwnu lwgY ]
t: sant kay dokhee ka-o daan laagai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

g: sMq ky doKI kau sB iqAwgY ]
t: sant kay dokhee ka-o sabh ti-aagai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.
The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.
The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.
The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

g: sMq kI dUKnw suK qy trY ]
t: sant kee dookhnaa sukh tay tarai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

g: sMq ky doKI kau nwhI Twau ]
t: sant kay dokhee ka-o naahee thaa-o.
e: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

g: nwnk sMq BwvY qw ley imlwie ]4]
t: naanak sant bhaavai taa la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||
e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

g: sMq kw doKI AD bIc qy tUtY ]
t: sant kaa dokhee aDh beech tay tootai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

g: sMq kw doKI ikqY kwij n phUcY ]
t: sant kaa dokhee kitai kaaj na pahoochai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

g: sMq ky doKI kau auidAwn BRmweIAY ]
t: sant kay dokhee ka-o udi-aan bharmaa-ee-ai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.
The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

g: sMq kw doKI AMqr qy QoQw ]
t: sant kaa dokhee antar tay thothaa.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

g: ijau sws ibnw imrqk kI loQw ]
t: ji-o saas binaa mirtak kee lothaa.
e: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

g: sMq ky doKI kI jV ikCu nwih ]
t: sant kay dokhee kee jarh kichh naahi.
e: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.
He himself must eat what he has planted.

g: sMq ky doKI kau Avru n rwKnhwru ]
t: sant kay dokhee ka-o avar na raakhanhaar.
e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

g: nwnk sMq BwvY qw ley aubwir ]5]
t: naanak sant bhaavai taa la-ay ubaar. ||5||
e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||
The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this
- like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

g: sMq kw doKI BUKw nhI rwjY ]
t: sant kaa dokhee bhookhaa nahee raajai.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,
as fire is not satisfied by fuel.
The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

g: ijau bUAwVu iqlu Kyq mwih duhylw ]
t: ji-o boo-aarh til khayt maahi duhaylaa.
e: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

g: sMq kw doKI Drm qy rhq ]
t: sant kaa dokhee Dharam tay rahat.
e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

g: sMq kw doKI sd imiQAw khq ]
t: sant kaa dokhee sad mithi-aa kahat.
e: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

g: ikrqu inMdk kw Duir hI pieAw ]
t: kirat nindak kaa Dhur hee pa-i-aa.
e: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

g: nwnk jo iqsu BwvY soeI iQAw ]6]
t: naanak jo tis bhaavai so-ee thi-aa. ||6||
e: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||

g: sMq kw doKI ibgV rUpu hoie jwie ]
t: sant kaa dokhee bigarh roop ho-ay jaa-ay.
e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

g: sMq ky doKI kau drgh imlY sjwie ]
t: sant kay dokhee ka-o dargeh milai sajaa-ay.
e: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.
The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

g: sMq kw doKI n mrY n jIvweIAY ]
t: sant kaa dokhee na marai na jeevaa-ee-ai.
e: He does not die, but he does not live either.

g: sMq ky doKI kI pujY n Awsw ]
t: sant kay dokhee kee pujai na aasaa.
e: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

g: sMq kw doKI auiT clY inrwsw ]
t: sant kaa dokhee uth chalai niraasaa.
e: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

g: sMq kY doiK n iqRstY koie ]
t: sant kai dokh na taristai ko-ay.
e: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.
As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;
no one can erase their past actions.
O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

g: sB Gt iqs ky Ehu krnYhwru ]
t: sabh ghat tis kay oh karnaihaar.
e: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.
Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

g: pRB kI ausqiq krhu idnu rwiq ]
t: parabh kee ustat karahu din raat.
e: Praise God, day and night.
Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

g: sBu kCu vrqY iqs kw kIAw ]
t: sabh kachh vartai tis kaa kee-aa.
e: Everything happens as He wills.
As He wills, so people become.
He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.
Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?

g: ijs no ik®pw krY iqsu Awpn nwmu dyie ]
t: jis no kirpaa karai tis aapan naam day-ay.
e: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.
Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||
Shalok:

g: qjhu isAwnp suir jnhu ismrhu hir hir rwie ]
t: tajahu si-aanap sur janhu simrahu har har raa-ay.
e: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

g: eyk Aws hir min rKhu nwnk dUKu Brmu Bau jwie ]1]
t: ayk aas har man rakhahu naanak dookh bharam bha-o jaa-ay. ||1||
e: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

g: mwnuK kI tyk ibRQI sB jwnu ]
t: maanukh kee tayk barithee sabh jaan.
e: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.
The Great Giver is the One Lord God.
By His gifts, we are satisfied,
and we suffer from thirst no longer.
The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.
Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

g: iqs kw hukmu bUiJ suKu hoie ]
t: tis kaa hukam boojh sukh ho-ay.
e: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

g: iqs kw nwmu rKu kMiT proie ]
t: tis kaa naam rakh kanth paro-ay.
e: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.
Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.
O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||
Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
O my mind, make this your true occupation.
Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.
Your soul shall be forever peaceful.
With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.
In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.
With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.
Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

g: kr hir krm sRvin hir kQw ]
t: kar har karam sarvan har kathaa.
e: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.
In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||
Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

g: sdw sdw hir ky gun gwih ]
t: sadaa sadaa har kay gun gaahi.
e: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.
Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,
are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

g: min qin muiK bolih hir muKI ]
t: man tan mukh boleh har mukhee.
e: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed
- know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.
One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

g: ieq auq kI Ehu soJI jwnY ]
t: it ut kee oh sojhee jaanai.
e: understands this world and the next.

g: nwm sMig ijs kw mnu mwinAw ]
t: naam sang jis kaa man maani-aa.
e: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,
the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||
By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;
know that then, his thirst is quenched.
In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

g: srb rog qy Ehu hir jnu rhq ]
t: sarab rog tay oh har jan rahat.
e: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.
Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.
In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

g: eyk aUpir ijsu jn kI Awsw ]
t: ayk oopar jis jan kee aasaa.
e: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

g: iqs kI ktIAY jm kI Pwsw ]
t: tis kee katee-ai jam kee faasaa.
e: - the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.
One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,
O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

g: ijs kau hir pRBu min iciq AwvY ]
t: jis ka-o har parabh man chit aavai.
e: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God
- that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.
Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

g: so syvku khu iks qy frY ]
t: so sayvak kaho kis tay darai.
e: - who do those servants need to fear?
As God is, so does He appear;
in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.
Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!
By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

g: jb dyKau qb sBu ikCu mUlu ]
t: jab daykh-a-u tab sabh kichh mool.
e: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.
O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||

g: nh ikCu jnmY nh ikCu mrY ]
t: nah kichh janmai nah kichh marai.
e: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
He Himself stages His own drama.
Coming and going, seen and unseen,
all the world is obedient to His Will.
He Himself is All-in-Himself.
In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.
He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.
He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.
Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.
As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||
Those who know God are glorious.
The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.
God's servants redeem all.
God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.
The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

g: gur kw sbdu jip Bey inhwl ]
t: gur kaa sabad jap bha-ay nihaal.
e: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.
He alone is committed to serve them,
upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.
Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

g: nwnk iqn purK kau aUqm kir mwnu ]7]
t: naanak tin purakh ka-o ootam kar maan. ||7||
e: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||

g: jo ikCu krY su pRB kY rMig ]
t: jo kichh karai so parabh kai rang.
e: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.
By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.
Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

g: pRB kw kIAw jn mIT lgwnw ]
t: parabh kaa kee-aa jan meeth lagaanaa.
e: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.
As He is, so does He appear.

g: ijs qy aupjy iqsu mwih smwey ]
t: jis tay upjay tis maahi samaa-ay.
e: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

g: Eie suK inDwn aunhU bin Awey ]
t: o-ay sukh niDhaan unhoo ban aa-ay.
e: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.
Unto His own, He has given His honor.
O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||
Shalok:

g: srb klw BrpUr pRB ibrQw jwnnhwr ]
t: sarab kalaa bharpoor parabh birthaa jaananhaar.
e: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

g: jw kY ismrin auDrIAY nwnk iqsu bilhwr ]1]
t: jaa kai simran uDhree-ai naanak tis balihaar. ||1||
e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.
He Himself cherishes all beings.

g: sgl kI icMqw ijsu mn mwih ]
t: sagal kee chintaa jis man maahi.
e: The cares of all are on His Mind;
no one is turned away from Him.

g: ry mn myry sdw hir jwip ]
t: ray man mayray sadaa har jaap.
e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.
The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.
By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,
even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

g: iqsu ibnu nwhI qyrY ikCu kwm ]
t: tis bin naahee tayrai kichh kaam.
e: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

g: giq nwnk jip eyk hir nwm ]1]
t: gat naanak jap ayk har naam. ||1||
e: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||
One who is good-looking should not be vain;

g: pRB kI joiq sgl Gt sohY ]
t: parabh kee jot sagal ghat sohai.
e: the Light of God is in all hearts.
Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

g: jw sBu ikCu iqs kw dIAw drbY ]
t: jaa sabh kichh tis kaa dee-aa darbai.
e: All riches are His gifts.
One may call himself a great hero,

g: pRB kI klw ibnw kh DwvY ]
t: parabh kee kalaa binaa kah Dhaavai.
e: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?
One who brags about giving to charities
- the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

g: ijsu gur pRswid qUtY hau rogu ]
t: jis gur parsaad tootai ha-o rog.
e: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego
- O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||
As a palace is supported by its pillars,

g: iqau gur kw sbdu mnih AsQMmnu ]
t: ti-o gur kaa sabad maneh asthamman.
e: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.
As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,
so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.
As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

g: gur drsnu dyiK min hoie ibgwsu ]
t: gur darsan daykh man ho-ay bigaas.
e: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

g: ijau mhw auidAwn mih mwrgu pwvY ] iqau swDU sMig imil joiq pRgtwvY ]
t: ji-o mahaa udi-aan meh maarag paavai. ti-o saaDhoo sang mil jot paragtaavai.
e: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.
I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;
O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||
O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?
You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.
God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.
Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

g: jo kCu krY soeI suKu mwnu ]
t: jo kachh karai so-ee sukh maan.
e: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.
Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?
What things did you bring with you?
You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.
Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.
O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||

g: ijsu vKr kau lYin qU AwieAw ]
t: jis vakhar ka-o lain too aa-i-aa.
e: This merchandise, which you have come to obtai
n - the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

g: qij AiBmwnu lyhu mn moil ] rwm nwmu ihrdy mih qoil ]
t: taj abhimaan layho man mol. raam naam hirday meh tol.
e: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind, purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.
Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.
Give up other corrupt entanglements.
"Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,
and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.
In this trade, only a few are trading.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

g: crn swD ky Doie Doie pIau ]
t: charan saaDh kay Dho-ay Dho-ay pee-o.
e: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
Dedicate your soul to the Holy.
Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.
Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.
From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

g: hir gun gwie AMimRq rsu cwKY ]
t: har gun gaa-ay amrit ras chaakhai.
e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.
Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.
All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||
He infuses life back into the dead.
He gives food to the hungry.

g: srb inDwn jw kI idRstI mwih ]
t: sarab niDhaan jaa kee daristee maahi.
e: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.
People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

g: sBu ikCu iqs kw Ehu krnY jogu ]
t: sabh kichh tis kaa oh karnai jog.
e: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

g: iqsu ibnu dUsr hoAw n hogu ]
t: tis bin doosar ho-aa na hog.
e: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

g: jip jn sdw sdw idnu rYxI ]
t: jap jan sadaa sadaa din rainee.
e: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

g: sB qy aUc inrml ieh krxI ]
t: sabh tay ooch nirmal ih karnee.
e: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

g: kir ikrpw ijs kau nwmu dIAw ]
t: kar kirpaa jis ka-o naam dee-aa.
e: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name
- O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||

g: jw kY min gur kI prqIiq ]
t: jaa kai man gur kee parteet.
e: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

g: iqsu jn AwvY hir pRBu cIiq ]
t: tis jan aavai har parabh cheet.
e: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.
He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.
The One Lord is in his heart.

g: scu krxI scu qw kI rhq ]
t: sach karnee sach taa kee rahat.
e: True are his actions; true are his ways.
True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.
True is his vision; true is his form.
He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.
One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True
- O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||
Shalok:

g: rUpu n ryK n rMgu ikCu iqRhu gux qy pRB iBMn ]
t: roop na raykh na rang kichh tarihu gun tay parabh bhinn.
e: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

g: iqsih buJwey nwnkw ijsu hovY supRsMn ]1]
t: tiseh bujhaa-ay naankaa jis hovai suparsan. ||1||
e: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.
Renounce your love and attachment to people.

g: iqs qy prY nwhI ikCu koie ]
t: tis tay parai naahee kichh ko-ay.
e: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.
The One Lord is pervading among all.
He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,
Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.
He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,
the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.
To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings
- this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||
He is the Fulfiller of wishes, who can give us Sanctuary;
that which He has written, comes to pass.

g: hrn Brn jw kw nyqR Poru ]
t: haran bharan jaa kaa naytar for.
e: He destroys and creates in the twinkling of an eye.

g: iqs kw mMqRü n jwnY horu ]
t: tis kaa mantar na jaanai hor.
e: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.

g: And rUp mMgl sd jw kY ]
t: anad roop mangal sad jaa kai.
e: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.

g: srb Qok sunIAih Gir qw kY ]
t: sarab thok sunee-ah ghar taa kai.
e: I have heard that all things are in His home.

g: rwj mih rwju jog mih jogI ]
t: raaj meh raaj jog meh jogee.
e: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.

g: qp mih qpIsru igRhsq mih BogI ]
t: tap meh tapeesar garihsat meh bhogee.
e: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Enjoyer.
By constant meditation, His devotee finds peace.

g: nwnk iqsu purK kw iknY AMqu n pwieAw ]2]
t: naanak tis purakh kaa kinai ant na paa-i-aa. ||2||
e: O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||

g: jw kI lIlw kI imiq nwih ]
t: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naahi.
e: There is no limit to His play.
All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.

g: ipqw kw jnmu ik jwnY pUqu ]
t: pitaa kaa janam ke jaanai poot.
e: What does the son know of his father's birth?
All are strung upon His string.

g: sumiq igAwnu iDAwnu ijn dyie ] jn dws nwmu iDAwvih syie ]
t: sumat gi-aan Dhi-aan jin day-ay. jan daas naam Dhi-aavahi say-ay.
e: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation on His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.

g: iqhu gux mih jw kau Brmwey ]
t: tihu gun meh jaa ka-o bharmaa-ay.
e: He leads some astray in the three qualities;
they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.
The high and the low are His places.
As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||

g: nwnw rUp nwnw jw ky rMg ]
t: naanaa roop naanaa jaa kay rang.
e: Many are His forms; many are His colors.
Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.
In so many ways, He has extended Himself.
The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.
He performs His many plays in an instant.
The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.
In so many ways, He created the creation.
He alone can estimate His worth.

g: sB Gt iqs ky sB iqs ky Twau ]
t: sabh ghat tis kay sabh tis kay thaa-o.
e: All hearts are His, and all places are His.

g: jip jip jIvY nwnk hir nwau ]4]
t: jap jap jeevai naanak har naa-o. ||4||
e: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||
The Naam is the Support of all creatures.
The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.

g: nwm ky Dwry isimRiq byd purwn ]
t: naam kay Dhaaray simrit bayd puraan.
e: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

g: nwm ky Dwry sunn igAwn iDAwn ]
t: naam kay Dhaaray sunan gi-aan Dhi-aan.
e: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.
The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.
The Naam is the Support of all bodies.

g: nwm ky Dwry purIAw sB Bvn ]
t: naam kay Dhaaray puree-aa sabh bhavan.
e: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.

g: nwm kY sMig auDry suin sRvn ]
t: naam kai sang uDhray sun sarvan.
e: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.

g: kir ikrpw ijsu AwpnY nwim lwey ]
t: kar kirpaa jis aapnai naam laa-ay.
e: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam

g: nwnk cauQy pd mih so jnu giq pwey ]5]
t: naanak cha-uthay pad meh so jan gat paa-ay. ||5||
e: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||

g: rUpu siq jw kw siq AsQwnu ]
t: roop sat jaa kaa sat asthaan.
e: His form is true, and true is His place.
His personality is true - He alone is supreme.

g: krqUiq siq siq jw kI bwxI ]
t: kartoot sat sat jaa kee banee.
e: His acts are true, and true is His Word.
The True Lord is permeating all.

g: siq krmu jw kI rcnw siq ]
t: sat karam jaa kee rachnaa sat.
e: True are His actions; His creation is true.
His root is true, and true is what originates from it.
True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.
All goes well for those who know Him.
The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.

g: ibsÍwsu siq nwnk gur qy pweI ]6]
t: bisvaas sat naanak gur tay paa-ee. ||6||
e: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||
True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.

g: siq qy jn jw kY irdY pRvys ]
t: sat tay jan jaa kai ridai parvays.
e: True are those into whose hearts He enters.
One who knows and loves the Truth

g: nwmu jpq qw kI giq hoie ]
t: naam japat taa kee gat ho-ay.
e: - chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.
He Himself knows His own state and condition.
He is the Creator Lord of His world.
No one else understands Him, although they may try.

g: krqy kI imiq n jwnY kIAw ]
t: kartay kee mit na jaanai kee-aa.
e: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.

g: nwnk jo iqsu BwvY so vrqIAw ]7]
t: naanak jo tis bhaavai so vartee-aa. ||7||
e: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||
Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!
One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.

g: pRB kY rMig rwic jn rhy ]
t: parabh kai rang raach jan rahay.
e: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.
Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.
They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.
In their company, the world is saved.
The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.

g: jn kY sMig eyk ilv lwgI ]
t: jan kai sang ayk liv laagee.
e: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.
His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16||
Shalok:
True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

g: hY iB scu nwnk hosI iB scu ]1]
t: hai bhe sach naanak hosee bhe sach. ||1||
e: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.
His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.
The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.
His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.
He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.
He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.
The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.
Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.
All is True to one who understands.
O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||
One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart
recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

g: jw kY irdY ibsÍwsu pRB AwieAw ]
t: jaa kai ridai bisvaas parabh aa-i-aa.
e: One whose heart is filled with faith in God
- the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.
Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.

g: ijs qy aupijAw iqsu mwih smwnw ]
t: jis tay upji-aa tis maahi samaanaa.
e: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.
When something blends with its own,

g: qw kau iBMn n khnw jweI ]
t: taa ka-o bhinn na kahnaa jaa-ee.
e: it cannot be said to be separate from it.
This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.
Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||
The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.
The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.

g: Twkur ky syvk kY min prqIiq ]
t: thaakur kay sayvak kai man parteet.
e: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.

g: Twkur ky syvk kI inrml rIiq ]
t: thaakur kay sayvak kee nirmal reet.
e: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.
The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.

g: pRB kw syvku nwm kY rMig ]
t: parabh kaa sayvak naam kai rang.
e: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
God is the Cherisher of His servant.
The Formless Lord preserves His servant.

g: so syvku ijsu dieAw pRBu DwrY ]
t: so sayvak jis da-i-aa parabh Dhaarai.
e: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.

g: nwnk so syvku swis swis smwrY ]3]
t: naanak so sayvak saas saas samaarai. ||3||
e: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||
He covers the faults of His servant.
He surely preserves the honor of His servant.
He blesses His slave with greatness.
He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

g: Apny syvk kI Awip piq rwKY ]
t: apnay sayvak kee aap pat raakhai.
