e: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.

g: qw kI giq imiq koie n lwKY ]
t: taa kee gat mit ko-ay na laakhai.
e: No one knows His state and extent.

g: pRB ky syvk kau ko n phUcY ]
t: parabh kay sayvak ka-o ko na pahoochai.
e: No one is equal to the servant of God.

g: pRB ky syvk aUc qy aUcy ]
t: parabh kay sayvak ooch tay oochay.
e: The servant of God is the highest of the high.
One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak

g: nwnk so syvku dh idis pRgtwieAw ]4]
t: naanak so sayvak dah dis paragtaa-i-aa. ||4||
e: - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||
He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;
it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

g: ijs kw swsu n kwFq Awip ]
t: jis kaa saas na kaadhat aap.
e: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away

g: qw kau rwKq dy kir hwQ ]
t: taa ka-o raakhat day kar haath.
e: - He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.
You may make all sorts of efforts,
but these attempts are in vain.

g: mwrY n rwKY Avru n koie ]
t: maarai na raakhai avar na ko-ay.
e: No one else can kill or preserve
- He is the Protector of all beings.
So why are you so anxious, O mortal?
Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||
Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

g: pI AMimRqu iehu mnu qnu DRpIAY ]
t: pee amrit ih man tan Dharpee-ai.
e: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.
The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;
they see no other than God.
Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

g: nwmo suKu hir nwm kw sMgu ]
t: naamo sukh har naam kaa sang.
e: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.
Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam
- their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.
While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

g: khu nwnk jn kY sd kwm ]6]
t: kaho naanak jan kai sad kaam. ||6||
e: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||
Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.
God Himself has given this gift to His servants.
Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,
they remain absorbed in God Himself.
They know the past and the present.
They recognize God's Own Command.
Who can describe His Glory?

g: iqs kw gunu kih eyk n jwnau ]
t: tis kaa gun kahi ayk na jaan-o.
e: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.
Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day
- says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

g: mn myry iqn kI Et lyih ]
t: man mayray tin kee ot layhi.
e: O my mind, seek their protection;

g: mnu qnu Apnw iqn jn dyih ]
t: man tan apnaa tin jan deh.
e: give your mind and body to those humble beings.
Those humble beings who recognizes God

g: so jnu srb Qok kw dwqw ]
t: so jan sarab thok kaa daataa.
e: are the givers of all things.

g: iqs kI srin srb suK pwvih ]
t: tis kee saran sarab sukh paavahi.
e: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.

g: iqs kY dris sB pwp imtwvih ]
t: tis kai daras sabh paap mitaaveh.
e: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.
So renounce all other clever devices,

g: iqsu jn kI qU syvw lwgu ]
t: tis jan kee too sayvaa laag.
e: and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.
Your comings and goings shall be ended.

g: nwnk iqsu jn ky pUjhu sd pYrw ]8]17]
t: naanak tis jan kay poojahu sad pairaa. ||8||17||
e: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17||
Shalok:

g: siq purKu ijin jwinAw siqguru iqs kw nwau ]
t: sat purakh jin jaani-aa satgur tis kaa naa-o.
e: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

g: iqs kY sMig isKu auDrY nwnk hir gun gwau ]1]
t: tis kai sang sikh uDhrai naanak har gun gaa-o. ||1||
e: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.
The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

g: isK kI guru durmiq mlu ihrY ]
t: sikh kee gur durmat mal hirai.
e: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.
Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.
The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

g: gur kw isKu ibkwr qy hwtY ]
t: gur kaa sikh bikaar tay haatai.
e: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

g: siqguru isK kau nwm Dnu dyie ]
t: satgur sikh ka-o naam Dhan day-ay.
e: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.
The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

g: siqguru isK kw hlqu plqu svwrY ]
t: satgur sikh kaa halat palat savaarai.
e: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

g: nwnk siqguru isK kau jIA nwil smwrY ]1]
t: naanak satgur sikh ka-o jee-a naal samaarai. ||1||
e: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||

g: gur kY igRih syvku jo rhY ]
t: gur kai garihi sayvak jo rahai.
e: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

g: gur kI AwigAw mn mih shY ]
t: gur kee aagi-aa man meh sahai.
e: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

g: Awps kau kir kCu n jnwvY ]
t: aapas ka-o kar kachh na janaavai.
e: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

g: hir hir nwmu irdY sd iDAwvY ]
t: har har naam ridai sad Dhi-aavai.
e: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.
One who sells his mind to the True Guru
- that humble servant's affairs are resolved.
One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
shall attain his Lord and Master.
He Himself grants His Grace;

g: nwnk so syvku gur kI miq lyie ]2]
t: naanak so sayvak gur kee mat lay-ay. ||2||
e: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

g: bIs ibsvy gur kw mnu mwnY ]
t: bees bisvay gur kaa man maanai.
e: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

g: so syvku prmysur kI giq jwnY ]
t: so sayvak parmaysur kee gat jaanai.
e: - that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

g: so siqguru ijsu irdY hir nwau ]
t: so satgur jis ridai har naa-o.
e: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

g: Aink bwr gur kau bil jwau ]
t: anik baar gur ka-o bal jaa-o.
e: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.
Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

g: bRhm mih jnu jn mih pwrbRhmu ]
t: barahm meh jan jan meh paarbarahm.
e: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.
He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.
By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.
O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||
Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.
Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.
Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,
and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.
Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.
The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

g: pUrw guru AK´E jw kw mMqR ]
t: pooraa gur akh-ya-o jaa kaa mantar.
e: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.
Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.
Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

g: nwnk ijsu BwvY iqsu ley imlwie ]4]
t: naanak jis bhaavai tis la-ay milaa-ay. ||4||
e: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||
The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

g: siq purK pUrn ibbyk ] kwhU bol n phucq pRwnI ]
t: sat purakh pooran bibayk. kaahoo bol na pahuchat paraanee.
e: The True Lord, of perfect perfection - no speech can take the mortal to Him.
God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.
He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

g: qw kI kImiq iknY n pweI ]
t: taa kee keemat kinai na paa-ee.
e: No one can estimate His worth.
Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.
In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

g: nwnk ijsu pRswid AYsw pRBu jpny ]5]
t: naanak jis parsaad aisaa parabh japnay. ||5||
e: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

g: iehu hir rsu pwvY jnu koie ]
t: ih har ras paavai jan ko-ay.
e: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.
Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

g: ausu purK kw nwhI kdy ibnws ] jw kY min pRgty gunqws ]
t: us purakh kaa naahee kaday binaas. jaa kai man pargatay guntaas.
e: That person whose mind is illuminated by the treasure of excellence, never dies.

g: AwT phr hir kw nwmu lyie ]
t: aath pahar har kaa naam lay-ay.
e: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.
The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

g: moh mwieAw kY sMig n lypu ]
t: moh maa-i-aa kai sang na layp.
e: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

g: mn mih rwKY hir hir eyku ]
t: man meh raakhai har har ayk.
e: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.
In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

g: nwnk Brm moh duK qh qy nwsy ]6]
t: naanak bharam moh dukh tah tay naasay. ||6||
e: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||
In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.
Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.
The fear of birth and death is dispelled,
by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.
Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

g: sgl ibAwiD mn qy KY nsy ]
t: sagal bi-aaDh man tay khai nasay.
e: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

g: ijs kw sw iqin ikrpw DwrI ]
t: jis kaa saa tin kirpaa Dhaaree.
e: He takes us into His favor as His own.
In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

g: suin nwnk hir hir jsu sRvn ]7]
t: sun naanak har har jas sarvan. ||7||
e: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||
He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.
Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.
God Himself sets His play in motion.
Only He Himself can estimate His worth.
There is none, other than the Lord.
Permeating all, He is the One.
Through and through, He pervades in form and color.
He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.
Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.
So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||
Shalok:

g: swiQ n cwlY ibnu Bjn ibiKAw sglI Cwru ]
t: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikhi-aa saglee chhaar.
e: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

g: hir hir nwmu kmwvnw nwnk iehu Dnu swru ]1]
t: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ih Dhan saar. ||1||
e: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.
Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Forget all other efforts, O my friend

g: crn kml ird mih auir Dwrhu ]
t: charan kamal rid meh ur Dhaarahu.
e: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.
God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

g: idRVu kir ghhu nwmu hir vQu ]
t: darirh kar gahhu naam har vath.
e: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.
Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.
Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.
Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.
All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

g: ijsu Dn kau cwir kuMt auiT Dwvih ]
t: jis Dhan ka-o chaar kunt uth Dhaaveh.
e: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

g: so Dnu hir syvw qy pwvih ]
t: so Dhan har sayvaa tay paavahi.
e: - you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

g: ijsu suK kau inq bwCih mIq ]
t: jis sukh ka-o nit baachheh meet.
e: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend
- that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

g: ijsu soBw kau krih BlI krnI ]
t: jis sobhaa ka-o karahi bhalee karnee.
e: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

g: sw soBw Bju hir kI srnI ]
t: saa sobhaa bhaj har kee sarnee.
e: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.
All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease
- the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

g: srb inDwn mih hir nwmu inDwnu ]
t: sarab niDhaan meh har naam niDhaan.
e: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.
Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.
Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

g: qw kau ibGnu n lwgY koie ]
t: taa ka-o bighan na laagai ko-ay.
e: No obstacle stands in the way of one

g: jw kY irdY bsY hir soie ]
t: jaa kai ridai basai har so-ay.
e: whose heart is filled with the Lord.
The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.
Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.
Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.
By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.
You shall go to that home, and live forever.
Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||
One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.
Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.
Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.
Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

g: ieau rqn jnm kw hoie auDwru ]
t: i-o ratan janam kaa ho-ay uDhaar.
e: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.
Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.
By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved
- not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

g: hir kI Bgiq krhu mnu lwie ]
t: har kee bhagat karahu man laa-ay.
e: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||
Your wealth shall not go with you;
why do you cling to it, you fool?
Children, friends, family and spouse

g: ien qy khhu qum kvn snwQw ]
t: in tay kahhu tum kavan sanaathaa.
e: - who of these shall accompany you?
Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya
- who has ever escaped from these?
Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry
- false shows and false displays.

g: ijin dIey iqsu buJY n ibgwnw ]
t: jin dee-ay tis bujhai na bigaanaa.
e: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;
forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

g: gur kI miq qUM lyih ieAwny ]
t: gur kee mat tooN layhi i-aanay.
e: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;
without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

g: hir kI Bgiq krhu mn mIq ]
t: har kee bhagat karahu man meet.
e: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;
your consciousness shall become pure.
Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;
the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.
Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

g: swr BUq siq hir ko nwau ]
t: saar bhoot sat har ko naa-o.
e: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.
With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||
Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.
The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.
You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.
With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.
Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.
So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.
In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.
See the One permeating all;

g: khu nwnk jw kY msqik lyKu ]7]
t: kaho naanak jaa kai mastak laykh. ||7||
e: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||
Meditate on the One, and worship the One.
Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.
Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.
With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.
The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.
The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.
The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.
Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

g: mn qn AMqir eyku pRBu rwqw ]
t: man tan antar ayk parabh raataa.
e: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||
Shalok:

g: iPrq iPrq pRB AwieAw pirAw qau srnwie ]
t: firat firat parabh aa-i-aa pari-aa ta-o sarnaa-ay.
e: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

g: nwnk kI pRB bynqI ApnI BgqI lwie ]1]
t: naanak kee parabh bayntee apnee bhagtee laa-ay. ||1||
e: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:
please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.
I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

g: sdw sdw pRB ky gun gwvau ]
t: sadaa sadaa parabh kay gun gaava-o.
e: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.
With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.
May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

g: Bgiq krau pRB kI inq nIiq ]
t: bhagat kara-o parabh kee nit neet.
e: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.
You are my only Shelter, my only Support.
Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

g: pRB kI idRsit mhw suKu hoie ]
t: parabh kee darisat mahaa sukh ho-ay.
e: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.
Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.
Those who taste it are satisfied.
They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.
They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.
Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.
Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.
Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||
The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.
From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.
Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.
He has made His servant eternally happy.
The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.
The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.
Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,
imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

g: ijs kw sw iqin lIAw imlwie ]
t: jis kaa saa tin lee-aa milaa-ay.
e: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.
Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||

g: so ikau ibsrY ij Gwl n BwnY ]
t: so ki-o bisrai je ghaal na bhaanai.
e: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

g: so ikau ibsrY ij kIAw jwnY ]
t: so ki-o bisrai je kee-aa jaanai.
e: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

g: so ikau ibsrY ijin sBu ikCu dIAw ]
t: so ki-o bisrai jin sabh kichh dee-aa.
e: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

g: so ikau ibsrY ij jIvn jIAw ]
t: so ki-o bisrai je jeevan jee-aa.
e: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

g: so ikau ibsrY ij Agin mih rwKY ]
t: so ki-o bisrai je agan meh raakhai.
e: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?
By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

g: so ikau ibsrY ij ibKu qy kwFY ]
t: so ki-o bisrai je bikh tay kaadhai.
e: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?
Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.
Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.
O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||
O friends, O Saints, make this your work.
Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.
By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.
All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.
Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.
All sorrows shall vanish.
O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||
Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
within my mind and body, this is my purpose:
beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.
My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

g: Bgq jnw kY min qin rMgu ]
t: bhagat janaa kai man tan rang.
e: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.
Rare is the one who obtains their company.
Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:
by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

g: qw kI aupmw khI n jwie ]
t: taa kee upmaa kahee na jaa-ay.
e: His Praises cannot be spoken;
O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||
God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.
He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.
The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,
the Nourisher of all beings.
The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.
The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

g: jo jo jpY su hoie punIq ]
t: jo jo japai so ho-ay puneet.
e: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,
focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.
I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.
Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||
Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

g: eyk inmK hir ky gun gwey ]
t: ayk nimakh har kay gun gaa-ay.
e: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.
So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

g: hir ky nwm kI kQw min BweI ]
t: har kay naam kee kathaa man bhaa-ee.
e: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.
Abundant foods, clothes and music
come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;
the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.
O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.
All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||
Shalok:

g: srgun inrgun inrMkwr suMn smwDI Awip ]
t: sargun nirgun nirankaar sunn samaaDhee aap.
e: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

g: Awpn kIAw nwnkw Awpy hI iPir jwip ]1]
t: aapan kee-aa naankaa aapay hee fir jaap. ||1||
e: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

g: jb Akwru iehu kCu n idRstyqw ]
t: jab akaar ih kachh na daristaytaa.
e: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

g: pwp puMn qb kh qy hoqw ]
t: paap punn tab kah tay hotaa.
e: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?
When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

g: qb bYr ibroD iksu sMig kmwiq ]
t: tab bair biroDh kis sang kamaat.
e: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

g: jb ies kw brnu ichnu n jwpq ]
t: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat.
e: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

g: qb hrK sog khu iksih ibAwpq ]
t: tab harakh sog kaho kiseh bi-aapat.
e: then who experienced joy and sorrow?
When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

g: qb moh khw iksu hovq Brm ]
t: tab moh kahaa kis hovat bharam.
e: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?
He Himself has staged His own drama;
O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||
When there was only God the Master,

g: qb bMD mukiq khu iks kau gnI ]
t: tab banDh mukat kaho kis ka-o ganee.
e: then who was called bound or liberated?
When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

g: qb nrk surg khu kaun Aauqwr ]
t: tab narak surag kaho ka-un a-utaar.
e: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?
When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

g: qb isv skiq khhu ikqu Twie ]
t: tab siv sakat kahhu kit thaa-ay.
e: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

g: jb Awpih Awip ApnI joiq DrY ]
t: jab aapeh aap apnee jot Dharai.
e: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

g: qb kvn infru kvn kq frY ]
t: tab kavan nidar kavan kat darai.
e: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?
He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;
O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||
When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

g: qh jnm mrn khu khw ibnwsn ]
t: tah janam maran kaho kahaa binaasan.
e: then where was birth, death and dissolution?
When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

g: qb jm kI qRws khhu iksu hoie ]
t: tab jam kee taraas kahhu kis ho-ay.
e: then who was afraid of death?
When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

g: qb icqR gupq iksu pUCq lyKw ]
t: tab chitar gupat kis poochhat laykhaa.
e: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?
When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

g: qb kaun Cuty kaun bMDn bwDy ]
t: tab ka-un chhutay ka-un banDhan baaDhay.
e: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?
He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

g: nwnk Awpn rUp Awp hI auprjw ]3]
t: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparjaa. ||3||
e: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

g: jh inrml purKu purK piq hoqw ]
t: jah nirmal purakh purakh pat hotaa.
e: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

g: qh ibnu mYlu khhu ikAw Doqw ]
t: tah bin mail kahhu ki-aa Dhotaa.
e: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?
When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

g: qh kaun kau mwn kaun AiBmwn ]
t: tah ka-un ka-o maan ka-un abhimaan.
e: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?
When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

g: qh Cl iCdR lgq khu kIs ]
t: tah chhal chhidar lagat kaho kees.
e: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

g: jh joiq srUpI joiq sMig smwvY ]
t: jah jot saroopee jot sang samaavai.
e: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,
then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?
He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.
O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

g: jb ApnI soBw Awpn sMig bnweI ]
t: jab apnee sobhaa aapan sang banaa-ee.
e: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

g: qb kvn mwie bwp imqR suq BweI ]
t: tab kavan maa-ay baap mitar sut bhaa-ee.
e: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?
When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

g: qh byd kqyb khw koaU cIn ]
t: tah bayd katayb kahaa ko-oo cheen.
e: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

g: jb Awpn Awpu Awip auir DwrY ]
t: jab aapan aap aap ur Dhaarai.
e: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,
then who considered omens to be good or bad?

g: jh Awpn aUc Awpn Awip nyrw ]
t: jah aapan ooch aapan aap nayraa.
e: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

g: qh kaun Twkuru kaunu khIAY cyrw ]
t: tah ka-un thaakur ka-un kahee-ai chayraa.
e: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?
We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.
O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||
When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,
then who was swayed by Maya?
When He paid homage to Himself,
then the three qualities were not prevailing.
When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

g: qh kaunu AicMqu iksu lwgY icMqw ]
t: tah ka-un achint kis laagai chintaa.
e: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?
When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,
then who spoke and who listened?
He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.
O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||
When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,
he made the world subject to the three dispositions.
Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.
Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.
Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,
egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;
pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor
- these came to be described in various ways.
He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.
He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||
Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.
He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
His Praise is to Himself alone.
He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.
He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

g: ijsu BwvY iqsu Awpn nwie lwvY ]
t: jis bhaavai tis aapan naa-ay laavai.
e: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.
He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.
He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

g: ijau bulwvhu iqau nwnk dws bolY ]8]21]
t: ji-o bulaavhu ti-o naanak daas bolai. ||8||21||
e: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||
Shalok:

g: jIA jMq ky Twkurw Awpy vrqxhwr ]
t: jee-a jant kay thaakuraa aapay vartanhaar.
e: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

g: nwnk eyko psirAw dUjw kh idRstwr ]1]
t: naanak ayko pasri-aa doojaa kah daristaar. ||1||
e: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

g: jw iqsu BwvY qw isRsit aupwey ]
t: jaa tis bhaavai taa sarisat upaa-ay.
e: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.
As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

g: qum qy iBMn nhI ikCu hoie ]
t: tum tay bhinn nahee kichh ho-ay.
e: Without You, nothing can be done.
Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

g: jw kau pRB jIau Awip buJwey ]
t: jaa ka-o parabh jee-o aap bujhaa-ay.
e: One whom God Himself inspires to understand
- that person obtains the True Name.
He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.
O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||

g: jIA jMqR sB qw kY hwQ ]
t: jee-a jantar sabh taa kai haath.
e: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

g: ijsu rwKY iqsu koie n mwrY ]
t: jis raakhai tis ko-ay na maarai.
e: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.
One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

g: iqsu qij Avr khw ko jwie ]
t: tis taj avar kahaa ko jaa-ay.
e: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?
Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

g: jIA kI jugiq jw kY sB hwiQ ]
t: jee-a kee jugat jaa kai sabh haath.
e: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.
Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.
He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.
Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.
His kindness extends to all.
He Himself knows His own ways.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.
He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

g: jo jo ricE su iqsih iDAwiq ]
t: jo jo rachi-o so tiseh Dhi-aat.
e: That which He has created meditates on Him.
Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

g: Bgiq krih hir ky gux gwie ]
t: bhagat karahi har kay gun gaa-ay.
e: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.
O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||
The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

g: iqs kI Aws n ibrQI jwie ]
t: tis kee aas na birthee jaa-ay.
e: His hopes do not go in vain.
The servant's purpose is to serve;
obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.
Beyond this, he has no other thought.
Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.
His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.
Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.
He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.
O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||
Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.
Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.
Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

g: AMimRq bcn hir ky gun gwau ]
t: amrit bachan har kay gun gaa-o.
e: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;
this is the way to save your mortal soul.
Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.
Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.
Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||
Embellish both this world and the next;
enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.
Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

g: ijsu min bsY iqsu swcu prIiKAw ]
t: jis man basai tis saach pareekhi-aa.
e: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

g: min qin nwmu jphu ilv lwie ]
t: man tan naam japahu liv laa-ay.
e: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

g: dUKu drdu mn qy Bau jwie ]
t: dookh darad man tay bha-o jaa-ay.
e: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.
Deal in the true trade, O trader,
and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.
Keep the Support of the One in your mind.
O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||

g: iqs qy dUir khw ko jwie ]
t: tis tay door kahaa ko jaa-ay.
e: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?
Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.
Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.
By God's Grace, mortals are released.

g: ijsu pRBu rwKY iqsu nwhI dUK ]
t: jis parabh raakhai tis naahee dookh.
e: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.
Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.
Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

g: iqsu jn kau koie n phucnhwru ]
t: tis jan ka-o ko-ay na pahuchanhaar.
e: No one can equal that humble servant.
The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.
O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||

g: miq pUrI AMimRqu jw kI idRsit ]
t: mat pooree amrit jaa kee darisat.
e: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.
Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.
His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.
The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.
Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

g: ijsu min bsY su hoq inhwlu ]
t: jis man basai so hot nihaal.
e: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

g: qw kY inkit n Awvq kwlu ]
t: taa kai nikat na aavat kaal.
e: Death does not draw near him.
One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,
meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||
Shalok:

g: igAwn AMjnu guir dIAw AigAwn AMDyr ibnwsu ]
t: gi-aan anjan gur dee-aa agi-aan anDhayr binaas.
e: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

g: hir ikrpw qy sMq ByitAw nwnk min prgwsu ]1]
t: har kirpaa tay sant bhayti-aa naanak man pargaas. ||1||
e: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.
God's Name is sweet to me.
All things are contained in the Heart of the One,
although they appear in so many various colors.

g: nau iniD AMimRqu pRB kw nwmu ]
t: na-o niDh amrit parabh kaa naam.
e: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.
Within the human body is its place of rest.
The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.
The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.
He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.
O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||
The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.
In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld
- in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.
In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.
As He orders, so do His creatures act.
He permeates the winds and the waters.
He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

g: iqs qy iBMn nhI ko Twau ]
t: tis tay bhinn nahee ko thaa-o.
e: Without Him, there is no place at all.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||
See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

g: bwxI pRB kI sBu ko bolY ]
t: banee parabh kee sabh ko bolai.
e: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.
He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.
With absolute power, He plays His play.
His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

g: srb joiq mih jw kI joiq ]
t: sarab jot meh jaa kee jot.
e: In all light, is His Light.
The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.
By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||

g: sMq jnw kw pyKnu sBu bRhm ]
t: sant janaa kaa paykhan sabh barahm.
e: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

g: sMq jnw kY ihrdY siB Drm ]
t: sant janaa kai hirdai sabh Dharam.
e: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.
The Saint hears words of goodness.
He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

g: ijin jwqw iqs kI ieh rhq ]
t: jin jaataa tis kee ih rahat.
e: This is the way of life of one who knows God.
True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

g: jo jo hoie soeI suKu mwnY ]
t: jo jo ho-ay so-ee sukh maanai.
e: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.
He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He dwells inside, and outside as well.
O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.
The entire creation came from God.
As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.
As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.
His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.
As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.
Who is near, and who is far away?
He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.
One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart
- O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||
In all forms, He Himself is pervading.
Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.
All the creation is His Body.
He Himself listens to His Own Praise.
The One has created the drama of coming and going.
He made Maya subservient to His Will.
In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

g: jo ikCu khxw su Awpy khY ]
t: jo kichh kahnaa so aapay kahai.
e: Whatever is said, He Himself says.
By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

g: nwnk jw BwvY qw ley smwie ]6]
t: naanak jaa bhaavai taa la-ay samaa-ay. ||6||
e: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

g: ies qy hoie su nwhI burw ]
t: is tay ho-ay so naahee buraa.
e: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.
Other than Him, who can do anything?
He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.
He Himself knows His Own Being.
He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.
Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

g: qw kI giq imiq khI n jwie ]
t: taa kee gat mit kahee na jaa-ay.
e: His state and extent cannot be described.
If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.
His actions are all approved and accepted.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

g: jo jwnY iqsu sdw suKu hoie ]
t: jo jaanai tis sadaa sukh ho-ay.
e: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.
God blends that one into Himself.
He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.
He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.
Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;
by his grace, the whole world is saved.
This is his purpose in life;

g: jn kY sMig iciq AwvY nwau ]
t: jan kai sang chit aavai naa-o.
e: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.
He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

g: nwnk iqsu jn kau sdw nmskwru ]8]23]
t: naanak tis jan ka-o sadaa namaskaar. ||8||23||
e: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||
Shalok:

g: pUrw pRBu AwrwiDAw pUrw jw kw nwau ]
t: pooraa parabh aaraaDhi-aa pooraa jaa kaa naa-o.
e: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.

g: nwnk pUrw pwieAw pUry ky gun gwau ]1]
t: naanak pooraa paa-i-aa pooray kay gun gaa-o. ||1||
e: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;
see the Supreme Lord God near you.
With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,
and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.
Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

g: sMq jnw kI DUir mn mMg ]
t: sant janaa kee Dhoor man mang.
e: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.
Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

g: hir Dn ky Bir lyhu BMfwr ]
t: har Dhan kay bhar layho bhandaar.
e: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.
Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||
Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss
- in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.
You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!
Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,
Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.
O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||
The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.
These are priceless rubies and gems.
One who listens and acts on them is saved.
He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

e: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.
The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.
Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||
Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.
Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

e: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.
I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.
The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;
the service of His servant has been rewarded.
I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,
hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.
By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.
O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

g: pRB kI ausqiq krhu sMq mIq ]

e: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,
with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.
Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.
He obtains the highest place of all.
He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

g: hir Dnu Kwit clY jnu soie ]

e: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,
O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||
Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;
wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;
learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;
The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;
the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

g: sB kY miD sgl qy audws ]

e: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;
beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;
to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

t: ih fal tis jan kai mukh bhanay. gur naanak naam bachan man sunay. ||6||
e: - these blessings come to one who, through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||
One who chants this treasure in his mind

g: sB jug mih qw kI giq hoie ]
t: sabh jug meh taa kee gat ho-ay.
e: - in every age, he attains salvation.
In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.
The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.
The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.
It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.
Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

e: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,
O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

g: ijsu min bsY sunY lwie pRIiq ]

e: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

g: iqsu jn AwvY hir pRBu cIiq ]

e: - that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

e: The pains of birth and death are removed.
The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

e: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.
The One Name permeates his mind.
Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

g: swD nwm inrml qw ky krm ]

e: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

e: His glory becomes the highest of all.
O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||
